verdict.rationale: ChatGPT's own docs describe web search that returns citations in the chat, plus a Work mode that searches the web, compares sources and summarizes findings to carry larger tasks to a reviewable result such as a drafted report. However, no dedicated deep-research run is documented, and the docs never state that the finished report itself carries citations; the capability is pieced together from separate features. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented deep-research mode or launch flow, evidence of autonomous many-source search depth, documented citations inside the final report, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can launch a deep research run that autonomously searches many sources and returns a cited report

citations.quote: Search the web, browse websites, compare sources, read files, analyze data, and summarize findings.
Search results and citations appear in the chat when ChatGPT uses web search.
Turn on Work in the switcher when you want ChatGPT to carry a larger task through to a reviewable result.
Create a deck, analyze files, draft a report, build a project plan
Turn research and analysis into documents, presentations, spreadsheets, and other finished work.
